name: web-botanical-dna-mobile-footer-with-scientist-photo
title: Scientist photograph beside two phones showing a grass-field hero and footer
whatItIs: A split image: at left a soft-focus portrait of a researcher writing on a clipboard, at right two phones on pale grey showing a sage overlay hero with an email field and lime button, and a footer over a grass photo with logo, links and contact.
whatItMeans: Credible and calm; real lab photography grounds the botanical brand.
techniques: Pair a documentary-style portrait with mobile screens.
Overlay a translucent grey panel on a grass photo for the hero.
Use a pale lime button for the one action.
Turn the footer into an image with white text.

vocabulary.definition: A candid photo of a person at work.
A footer built over a photo.
A translucent panel over an image.
An email input with a button.
